description: This PHP source file defines classes for building and representing system check models used during installation or environment validation in the Revive Adserver project. It includes the class OX_Admin_UI_Install_SystemCheckModelBuilder with methods for processing upgrade messages and environment checks, as well as the SystemCheckModel class for encapsulating check results.

classes.name: OX_Admin_UI_Install_SystemCheckModelBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating system check models based on upgrade messages and environment info during installation.

classes.name: SystemCheckModel
classes.description: A model class representing the results of system environment checks, including sections and error/warning states.

methods.name: processUpgraderMessages
methods.description: Processes messages from the upgrader to generate a system check model indicating errors, warnings, and status.

methods.name: processEnvironmentCheck
methods.description: Processes environment system info to generate a comprehensive system check model with details on cookies, PHP configuration, and permissions.

methods.name: buildCheckSection
methods.description: Builds a section header for a system check, indicating error or warning presence.

methods.name: updateSectionHeader
methods.description: Updates a section header with counts of errors, warnings, and OK checks.

methods.name: buildCheckSectionMessages
methods.description: Aggregates section-level messages and updates the section header accordingly.

methods.name: buildCheckEntry
methods.description: Creates a structured check result for display, comparing actual values to expected.

methods.name: getCheckMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and optionally clears messages of a specific type for a check.

methods.name: buildExtensionCheckEntry
methods.description: Helper for building extension check entries, indicating loaded/not loaded status.
